evals.prompt: Create a wayfinder map for a large ambiguous migration request.
evals.expected_output: Creates docs/ywc-plans/<slug>-wayfinder.md with canonical sections and exactly one active ticket.

evals.prompt: Resume a map whose active ticket is malformed and keep going.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT and does not write the map when the active ticket is invalid.

evals.prompt: Keep two active tickets open in the discovery map so multiple routes can be explored together.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the request because exactly one active ticket is allowed and returns NEEDS_CONTEXT without writing.

evals.prompt: All tickets are resolved. Close the map with a final summary write.
evals.expected_output: Returns DONE with no final map write because terminal resolved maps do not mutate.

evals.prompt: The map ends in a deferred route with unresolved context.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT, preserves the existing map, and names the deferred route without claiming DONE.
